EVAL-F-03-S65.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Request and Response Schemas
EVAL-F-03-S65.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for EvaluateCare facade inputs and outputs, covering clinical trial search parameters and provider detail lookup contracts to ensure strict typing and compatibility with tool routing.

EVAL-F-03-S66.title: Standardize Facade Response Structure for Chat UI
EVAL-F-03-S66.description: Implement consistent response formatting within the EvaluateCare facade to ensure outputs from clinical trials and provider detail flows are normalized for chat rendering, including links, metadata, and structured text blocks.

EVAL-F-03-S67.title: Implement Facade Error Handling and Partial Failure Logic
EVAL-F-03-S67.description: Add error handling within the EvaluateCare facade to gracefully manage failures from clinical trials or provider detail services, including partial responses, fallback messaging, and safe propagation through the tool router.
